full_judgment:
Md. Hamidul Haque, J: Petitioner who is an accused in Petition Case No. 1025 of 1995 of the Court of Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka seeks leave to appeal against the judgment and order passed by the High Court Division in Criminal Misc. Case No. 2892 of 1999 discharging the Rule under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure. 

 2. The petitioner as an accused filed an application under section 241A of the Code of Criminal Procedure in the above Petition Case No. 1025 of 1995 before the Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka for discharging her. The learned Magistrate rejected that application and framed charge under section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act. Thereafter, the petitioner filed the above Criminal Misc. Case before the High Court Division for qushment of the proceeding. The High Court Division discharged the Rule by the impugned judgment and order.
